# Hold versus sell: auto-generated findings

Test: for each of 123 start weeks, store 12 weeks (spoilage 3.1%/week, storage Rs 8/quintal/week) vs sell immediately. Interest ignored.

- Storing 12 weeks beat selling immediately in **21%** of start weeks. With hindsight (best week chosen after the fact) it was **63%**.
- The median outcome of storing 12 weeks was **-45%** of the starting price.
- Break-even weekly price rise by starting price level: Rs 1,000 -> 4.0%, Rs 1,146 -> 3.9%, Rs 2,000 -> 3.6%, Rs 3,000 -> 3.5%.
- Share of start weeks where storing won, by year: 2019: 0% (n=1), 2020: 29% (n=52), 2021: 21% (n=52), 2022: 0% (n=18).
